parts.label: Hijri header alignment
upstream_facts: The upstream Hijri calendar keeps its nav buttons locked to the calendar root.
The docs-path example should preserve the same root-relative nav geometry on the UI Gallery surface.
fret_facts: The UI Gallery Hijri snippet exposes stable nav test ids and a stable calendar root for root-relative geometry checks.
The captured layout sidecar stores the calendar root separately from the page shell.

checks.expected: The previous-month button should keep the upstream root-relative position and remain a 32px square.

promotion.reason: The Hijri header geometry should stay reviewable as a reusable fixture-level gate.

parts.label: Hijri selected day alignment
upstream_facts: The upstream Hijri calendar keeps the selected day anchored to a stable 32px cell inside the calendar root.
The docs-path example should keep the selected-day geometry aligned with the upstream calendar grid.
fret_facts: The UI Gallery Hijri snippet exposes a stable selected-day test id, so the parity harness can measure the selected date directly instead of inferring it from text.
The selected day sits inside the same captured calendar root as the header, which makes root-relative geometry checks deterministic.

checks.expected: The selected day should keep the upstream root-relative position and remain a 32px square.

promotion.reason: The Hijri selected-day geometry should stay reviewable as a reusable fixture-level gate.
